settings.text: It has a wet, creamy texture that glides on smoothly, coating each lash evenly without clumping.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Is the formula waterproof?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Soulgazer isn’t waterproof, but it’s c…
settings.text: Soulgazer isn’t waterproof, but it’s clinically tested to be long-wearing, smudge-resistant, and flake-free, holding up beautifully through all-day wear.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Is this a lengthening, volumizing masc…
settings.text: Is this a lengthening, volumizing mascara or both?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Both! Soulgazer lengthens, lifts, and …
settings.text: Both! Soulgazer lengthens, lifts, and separates lashes while delivering defined volume. It’s powered by Myristoyl Pentapeptide-17, a peptide clinically tested to support stronger, healthier, and longer lashes over time.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Can i layer multiple coats?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Absolutely. The buildable formula lets…
settings.text: Absolutely. The buildable formula lets you customize your look—from natural and fluttery to bold and full—with zero clumping.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Does it hold a curl?
settings.text: Does it hold a curl?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Yes! The lightweight, flexible formula…
settings.text: Yes! The lightweight, flexible formula helps lift and hold lashes in place all day—no stiffness or crunchiness.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Soulgazer Mascara easily removes with …
settings.text: Soulgazer Mascara easily removes with warm water and a gentle cleanser or makeup remover—no tugging or harsh rubbing required.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Yes, Soulgazer is ophthalmologist-test…
settings.text: Yes, Soulgazer is ophthalmologist-tested, hypoallergenic, and safe for sensitive eyes and contact lens wearers.
